questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion with the passive voice to emphasise the agent in a hypothetical scenario?
options: Had they known the truth, the investigation would have been delayed.
Only when the evidence was gathered properly did the case begin to look promising.
If she had been given the opportunity, she would have spoken up immediately.
It was not until the suspect was arrested that the police realised the full extent of the conspiracy.
questions.answer: Only when the evidence was gathered properly did the case begin to look promising.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the use of a cleft construction to highlight the subject of a complex clause?
options: What matters most is that the project was completed on time despite the challenges.
It was not until the final report was submitted that the team received their bonuses.
The fact that he had been warned not to proceed was overlooked entirely.
What surprised everyone was that the experiment had been conducted without proper safety protocols.
questions.answer: What matters most is that the project was completed on time despite the challenges.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a third conditional with the subjunctive mood to express regret over past actions?
options: If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam.
If she had been more careful, she wouldn’t have fallen.
If he had received the invitation sooner, he would have attended the conference.
If they had not been so late, they would have caught the train.
questions.answer: If she had been more careful, she wouldn’t have fallen.

questions.question: Which sentence uses ellipsis effectively to maintain formal register and conciseness in a complex sentence?
options: Although the proposal was initially rejected, the committee discussed it further before reaching a decision.
He was surprised that she had not mentioned her plans, especially since she usually does.
It was evident from his tone that he was not happy with the outcome, which was unexpected given their previous discussions.
She left the meeting early, having realised that the discussion was becoming irrelevant to her interests.
questions.answer: She left the meeting early, having realised that the discussion was becoming irrelevant to her interests.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the correct use of a second conditional with a passive construction to express hypothetical circumstances?
options: If the data were analysed correctly, the results would have been accurate.
If she had been informed sooner, she would have taken different precautions.
If they had not been interrupted, the presentation would have continued uninterrupted.
If he had known the rules, he would have avoided the penalty.
questions.answer: If the data were analysed correctly, the results would have been accurate.
